bug_summary: クラッシュ再初期化時、postmasterのon_shmem_exitコールバックが常駐共有メモリセグメントとセマフォ集合を解放してしまい、次にforkされるauxプロセスが解放済みのマッピング/セマフォを参照してSIGSEGV・EINVALで落ちていた。

pr_title: Simplify shared memory and semaphore shutdown callbacks
pr_description: Removes the postmaster/aux-process environment branching from `release_semaphores` and `anonymous_shmem_detach`, along with the long-form divergence-from-C comments explaining it. Both `on_shmem_exit` callbacks now run the same release/detach sequence unconditionally, which lines up better with how the rest of the shutdown path is structured.
